\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 237-240 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R245-first-pass-words-from-chapters-237-240}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a bakery and a library.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to put out, to light, to bring to a halt, to cross, to go on an outing
  \item to die, to increase, to reduce, to chase, to believe
  \item to kiss, to paint, to play music, to give back, to remember
  \item to block, to hand in, to dive, to sink, to float
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To put out? (\textbf{\bn{নেভানো}}, \emph{nebhāno}.) To light? (\textbf{\bn{জ্বালানো}}, \emph{jvālāno}.) To bring to a halt? (\textbf{\bn{থামানো}}, \emph{thāmāno}.) To cross? (\textbf{\bn{পার} \bn{হওয়া}}, \emph{pār hôoyā}.) To go on an outing? (\textbf{\bn{বেড়ানো}}, \emph{beṛāno}.) To die? (\textbf{\bn{মরা}}, \emph{môrā}.) To increase? (\textbf{\bn{বাড়ানো}}, \emph{bāṛāno}.) To reduce? (\textbf{\bn{কমানো}}, \emph{kômāno}.) To chase? (\textbf{\bn{তাড়া} \bn{করা}}, \emph{tāṛā kôrā}.) To believe? (\textbf{\bn{বিশ্বাস} \bn{করা}}, \emph{bishvās kôrā}.) To kiss? (\textbf{\bn{চুমু} \bn{খাওয়া}}, \emph{chumu khāoyā}.) To paint? (\textbf{\bn{রং} \bn{করা}}, \emph{rông kôrā}.) To play music? (\textbf{\bn{বাজানো}}, \emph{bājāno}.) To give back? (\textbf{\bn{ফিরিয়ে} \bn{দেওয়া}}, \emph{phiriye deoyā}.) To remember? (\textbf{\bn{মনে} \bn{রাখা}}, \emph{mône rākhā}.) To block? (\textbf{\bn{আটকানো}}, \emph{āṭkāno}.) To hand in? (\textbf{\bn{জমা} \bn{দেওয়া}}, \emph{jômā deoyā}.) To dive? (\textbf{\bn{ঝাঁপ} \bn{দেওয়া}}, \emph{jhā̃p deoyā}.) To sink? (\textbf{\bn{ডোবা}}, \emph{ḍobā}.) To float? (\textbf{\bn{ভাসা}}, \emph{bhāsā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 241-245 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R245-second-pass-words-from-chapters-241-245}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to get lost and to find.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to get lost, to find, to notice, to inform, to chat
  \item to go out, to scatter, to roll up, to wrap, to dig
  \item vomiting, an itch, a beard, a moustache, a chin
  \item a border, a government, a nation, an island, a restaurant
  \item a cinema hall, a gym, a hair salon, a bakery, a library
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To get lost? (\textbf{\bn{হারিয়ে} \bn{যাওয়া}}, \emph{hāriye jāoyā}.) To find? (\textbf{\bn{খুঁজে} \bn{পাওয়া}}, \emph{khũje pāoyā}.) To notice? (\textbf{\bn{খেয়াল} \bn{করা}}, \emph{kheyāl kôrā}.) To inform? (\textbf{\bn{জানানো}}, \emph{jānāno}.) To chat? (\textbf{\bn{গল্প} \bn{করা}}, \emph{gôlpô kôrā}.) To go out? (\textbf{\bn{বেরোনো}}, \emph{berono}.) To scatter? (\textbf{\bn{ছড়ানো}}, \emph{chhôṛāno}.) To roll up? (\textbf{\bn{গোটানো}}, \emph{goṭāno}.) To wrap? (\textbf{\bn{মোড়া}}, \emph{moṛā}.) To dig? (\textbf{\bn{খোঁড়া}}, \emph{khõṛā}.) Vomiting? (\textbf{\bn{বমি}}, \emph{bômi}.) An itch? (\textbf{\bn{চুলকানি}}, \emph{chulkāni}.) A beard? (\textbf{\bn{দাড়ি}}, \emph{dāṛi}.) A moustache? (\textbf{\bn{গোঁফ}}, \emph{gõph}.) A chin? (\textbf{\bn{চিবুক}}, \emph{chibuk}.) A border? (\textbf{\bn{সীমান্ত}}, \emph{sīmāntô}.) A government? (\textbf{\bn{সরকার}}, \emph{sôrkār}.) A nation? (\textbf{\bn{জাতি}}, \emph{jāti}.) An island? (\textbf{\bn{দ্বীপ}}, \emph{dvīp}.) A restaurant? (\textbf{\bn{রেস্তোরাঁ}}, \emph{restorā̃}.) A cinema hall? (\textbf{\bn{সিনেমা} \bn{হল}}, \emph{sinemā hôl}.) A gym? (\textbf{\bn{জিম}}, \emph{jim}.) A hair salon? (\textbf{\bn{সেলুন}}, \emph{selun}.) A bakery? (\textbf{\bn{বেকারি}}, \emph{bekāri}.) A library? (\textbf{\bn{লাইব্রেরি}}, \emph{lāibreri}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
